sections.title: Advanced Level Concepts
sections.content: Level 3 covers trigonometry, symmetry, complex circle and polygon problems. It includes angle equations, distances inside/outside circles, and complex polygon area formulas.

sections.title: Advanced Triangle Properties
sections.content: Use trigonometry. Apply cosine and sine rules. Relationships between height, median, and centroid. Use triangle centers: incenter, circumcenter, centroid, orthocenter.

sections.title: Circles and Tangents
sections.content: Internal and external lines in a circle. Angle calculations between tangent and center. Tangent points and distances between two circles.

sections.title: Complex Polygon Properties
sections.content: Areas of regular and irregular polygons. Complex calculations of interior and exterior angles. Using trigonometry in polygons.

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content: Incorrect use of trigonometric formulas. Errors in calculating distances and angles of centers. Mistakes in complex polygon area formulas.

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content: Focus on trigonometry, centers of triangles, tangents, and complex polygon properties. Deep understanding of formulas and concepts is essential.

tricks.title: Cosine Rule
tricks.explanation: For any triangle: a² = b² + c² - 2bc cosA

tricks.title: Triangle Centers
tricks.explanation: Centroid = intersection of medians; Incenter = intersection of angle bisectors; Circumcenter = intersection of perpendicular bisectors
tricks.example: Centroid divides median in 2:1 ratio from vertex

tricks.title: Circle Tangent Points
tricks.explanation: Tangent forms 90° with radius; distance between two circles = distance between centers ± radii
tricks.example: r1=4, r2=6, center distance=12; external tangent distance = 12-4-6=2

tricks.title: Complex Polygon Area
tricks.explanation: Divide polygon into triangles and sum their areas.
tricks.example: Divide pentagon into 3 triangles and add their areas

tricks.title: Use Symmetry
tricks.explanation: Known side/angle in symmetric polygon helps find the rest quickly
tricks.example: In parallelogram, opposite sides and angles are equal

tricks.title: Trigonometric Shortcuts
tricks.explanation: Use 30°-60°-90° and 45°-45°-90° triangles for quick side calculations
tricks.example: 30°-60°-90°: sides = 1 : √3 : 2; small side 5 cm → long = 5√3 cm, hypotenuse = 10 cm

tricks.title: Distance Ratios in Centers
tricks.explanation: Centroid divides median 2:1; Incenter distance from vertex known by formula
tricks.example: Median = 9 cm; centroid to base = 6 cm, remaining = 3 cm above
